app: **Some units cannot be at half-strength:** If a model’s W characteristic or a unit’s starting strength cannot be evenly divided in half, that model or unit cannot be at half-strength (but can be below half-strength as described above).
source: only in the less authoritative Wahapedia core rules (not in core, uru, the Faction Packs)
reason: Layout cross-reference. The Core Rules print the half-strength table to the right of this box ("as described on the right"); the app lists it above this line, so it keeps Wahapedia's wording "as described above". Every other word is the Core Rules text. PROPOSED: the coordinator decides whether the app keeps "above" or prints "on the right".
evidence: GW Core Rules PDF p86, box "Some units cannot be at half-strength": "(but can be below half-strength as described on the right)"; Wahapedia core rules 01.02.01 Starting Strength and Half-Strength: "(but can be below half-strength as described above)".

app:
**Resolve a charge** with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the **charge roll**, you must select one of the following modes:
- **Leap to Defend:** When selecting **charge targets**, you can only select enemy units that made a **charge move** this phase and are within the **maximum distance**.
- **Into the Fray (+1CP):** When making the **charge roll**, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting **charge targets**, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the **maximum distance**.

While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: ▪ Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. ▪ Into the Fray: ▫ When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. ▫ When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance. | differs at "…aximum distance. into the fray[ (+1cp): when making the charge roll, if…]" vs source "…aximum distance. into the fray[: when making the charge roll, if the re…]"
reason: Formatting of a layout element, no word changed: the Core Rules print the +1CP cost as a badge beside the Into the Fray mode and its two effects as sub-bullets; the app writes the cost as "(+1CP)" after the mode name and the two sub-bullets as one bullet (cpNote also says "Into the Fray +1CP").

app:
If your Army Faction is **WORLD EATERS**, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.
*Example: Ash makes a Blessings of Khorne roll, getting the following: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6.*
*First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4.*
*They then use the two 2s to activate Unbridled Bloodlust.*
*Now that two Blessings of Khorne have been activated, no more can be activated and the remaining dice are discarded.*

reason: Typo fixed: Wahapedia prints the example dice as "1,2, 2, 2, 3, 4" (missing space); the app writes "1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4" like the other dice lists of the same example. No pack prints this army rule.
evidence: Wahapedia world-eaters, Army Rules, Blessings of Khorne, Example: "leaving the following dice: 1,2, 2, 2, 3, 4."; data.js comment above the text says the same.

app: If your Army Faction is **THOUSAND SONS**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals from those listed below. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test for that model by following the sequence below.
source: matches the less authoritative Wahapedia main text, not the Faction Pack: Rules Updates "Change first paragraph to:": if your army faction is thousand sons, at the start of your shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt rituals from those listed on the right. to do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a ritual this turn and select one ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a psychic test for that model by following the sequence below. | differs at "…mpt rituals from those listed [below. to do so, select one model from y…]" vs source "…mpt rituals from those listed [on the right. to do so, select one model…]"
reason: Layout cross-reference. The Faction Pack's Rules Update rewrites the first paragraph with "from those listed on the right" (the codex prints the Rituals beside it); the app prints the Rituals below the text and keeps Wahapedia's "listed below". The rest of the paragraph is the pack's text word for word. PROPOSED: the coordinator decides whether the app prints "on the right".
evidence: GW Faction Pack Thousand Sons v1.3 PDF p9, Rules Updates, Army Rules, Cabal of Sorcerers, "Change first paragraph to": "…attempt Rituals from those listed on the right.…"; Wahapedia thousand-sons Army Rules: "…listed below.…" (its errata spoiler repeats the pack's "on the right").
